findings.item: Sun/shadow node metric (recommendation 4, Arch540 C_design_space principle)
findings.issue: The packet makes the Arch540 demo metric (average winter-solstice sun hours, 9:00-15:00 solar time, on the lot plus a 15 m ring) the v1 sun node and calls it 'the course-recognised sun metric'. That metric is the objective of a teaching harness: an 80 x 60 m lot, buildings of at most 14 storeys, and a file headed 'Part of the protected harness: do not edit'. For a full downtown block, dtmass's README (line 38) lists the Solar Access Guidelines for the Downtown Peninsula (Council, 17 Sep 2025) with the test 'new shadow on listed parks, equinox 10:00-16:00'. City search results describe the same window as 10am-4pm PDT on the Fall Equinox, with Basic and Detailed study types. The packet already lists dtmass as the policy reading list but never connects the two. Its solar-time instruction also conflicts with a clock-time (PDT) window. The 2.0-2.5 km domain sizing is based on the solstice and overstates the regulatory domain. Our arithmetic for equinox at 10:00 PDT (about 08:55 apparent solar time) gives shadows of about 480-600 m, and about 280-355 m at noon.
findings.fix: Make the primary v1 sun output a no-new-shadow test on listed parks and public open space: fall equinox, 10:00-16:00 PDT clock time, real dates and longitude (suncalc does this natively), cited to the 2025 Downtown guideline. Keep Arch540 solstice sun hours as a secondary, labelled 'course teaching metric'. Size the domain per test, not from the solstice. Check whether the July 2025 Council motion to study a 10:00-14:00 window changed the adopted guideline. Re-open the guideline PDF, which returned 403 to our fetcher, before you encode any numbers.

findings.issue: The hooks docs say onFailure 'has no effect on Stop, SubagentStop, TaskCompleted and TeammateIdle hooks' (verified 21 Oct). A_writing's guard is a Stop hook, so 'set onFailure to block' cannot make that gate fail closed. The docs also say exec form (`args`) on Windows needs `command` to resolve to a real .exe. That suits `.venv\Scripts\python.exe` but rules out .cmd shims.
findings.fix: Put every enforcing gate on PreToolUse (as B, C and D do), with exec form: command = `.venv/Scripts/python.exe`, args = [hook path], onFailure 'block'. Treat Stop-hook guards as advisory only and cover them with the CI exit-code test.

findings.issue: The row does not say that rhino-gh-mcp also needs uv. Its README lists `brew install uv` for Mac and an absolute uv path (lines 182 and 289), and uv is absent on the session machine.
findings.fix: Add 'needs uv' to the risks. The environment recommendation already installs uv, so cross-reference it.

findings.issue: SerjoschDuering/rhino-mcp and alfredatnycu/grasshopper-mcp are listed as not opened. Checked now. SerjoschDuering/rhino-mcp has no LICENSE (404 on main and master); it runs arbitrary Python in Rhino and Grasshopper and calls Replicate for AI renders. alfredatnycu/grasshopper-mcp is MIT (c) 2025 Alfred Chen and supports Rhino 7 or higher, the only option here for teammates on Rhino 7, since rhino-gh-mcp is Rhino 8 only.
findings.fix: Add one-line rows. Reject SerjoschDuering/rhino-mcp for reuse because it has no licence and a broad execution surface; you may read it for its Replicate render wiring. Mark alfredatnycu/grasshopper-mcp as a Rhino 7 fallback, roadmap only.

findings.issue: 'Node 22+ LTS' and 'winget package IDs unconfirmed' leave a teammate guessing. Node 22 is in maintenance and reaches end of life in April 2027. Node 24 is the current LTS line.
findings.fix: Recommend Node 24 LTS (22 is acceptable). Confirm `winget show OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS` and `winget show astral-sh.uv` on one machine before writing the setup doc. These IDs come from general knowledge and are not verified this round.

false_assumptions.claim: The Arch540 C_design_space winter-solstice sun-hours method (9:00-15:00 solar time, lot plus 15 m ring) is the course-recognised sun metric for our tower node, and the domain must reach about 2-2.5 km.
false_assumptions.why_false: It is the objective of a teaching harness for an 80 x 60 m lot with buildings of at most 14 storeys. The City's governing test for a downtown site is new shadow on listed parks at the fall equinox, 10:00-16:00 PDT, which is clock time, not solar time.
false_assumptions.correction: Make the primary v1 test equinox 10:00-16:00 PDT no-new-shadow on listed parks and public open space, cited to the Downtown Peninsula Solar Access Guidelines (Council, 17 Sep 2025). Keep solstice sun hours as a secondary teaching metric, and size the domain per test (about 0.5-0.6 km at 10:00 PDT on the equinox).
false_assumptions.evidence: raw.githubusercontent.com/xubynii/dtmass/main/README.md line 38; evaluate.py docstring lines 23-25 and constants LOT_W/LOT_D 80/60, MAX_STOREYS 14; web search results for guidelines.vancouver.ca/guidelines-solar-access-downtown.pdf (the PDF itself returned 403 to us).

false_assumptions.claim: Setting onFailure: block makes the demo-style gates fail closed.
false_assumptions.why_false: The hooks docs state that onFailure has no effect on Stop, SubagentStop, TaskCompleted or TeammateIdle hooks, and A_writing's gate is a Stop hook.
false_assumptions.correction: Enforce gates through PreToolUse hooks in exec form with the venv python.exe. Treat Stop hooks as advisory.

verdict: Round 3 is mostly sound. Repo stats, licences and the 3.13t wheel gap re-verified, along with the POSIX-only demos and the hairline, anatomy and text-to-cad facts. All earlier MAJORs are fixed except the sun node. The packet still treats the Arch540 demo's winter-solstice, solar-time sun hours as the main metric. For a downtown block, the governing test is no new shadow on listed parks at the fall equinox, 10:00-16:00 PDT (2025 guideline), which also changes the domain size. Smaller fixes: Stop hooks cannot fail closed with onFailure; rhino-gh-mcp also needs uv; the unscoped hairline package dates from 2019; two starred Rhino MCPs still need rows. The team can act now if the sun recommendation is rewritten.
